text:
```artifact
Feature: Lab Management System

  Scenario: Lab In-charge views and updates open lab-requests
    Given the lab-in-charge is logged in
    And there are open lab-requests
    When the lab-in-charge views the open lab-requests
    Then the lab-in-charge should see the list of open lab-requests
    And the lab-in-charge should be able to update the status of a lab-request
    And the status update should be saved successfully

  Scenario: Patient views and prints Prescription and Invoice
    Given the patient is logged in
    And there is a Prescription for the patient
    When the patient views the Prescription
    Then the patient should see the Prescription
    And the patient should be able to print the Invoice
    And the Invoice should be printed successfully

  Scenario: Admin prints and emails Prescription and Invoice
    Given the admin is logged in
    And there is a Prescription for the patient
    When the admin prints the Prescription
    Then the Prescription should be printed successfully
    And the admin should be able to email the Invoice
    And the Invoice should be emailed successfully

  Scenario Outline: Quarterly archiving of Patient Profiles and Consultation Requests
    Given the current date is <current_date>
    And there are Patient Profiles with no Consultation Request for the last 3 years
    And there are Consultation Requests more than 3 years old
    When the system runs the quarterly archiving process
    Then the Patient Profiles should be archived
    And the Consultation Requests should be archived

    Examples:
      | current_date |
      | 2023-04-01   |
      | 2023-07-01   |
      | 2023-10-01   |
      | 2023-12-31   |
```
